mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_member (project_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.name AS name, u.profile_image AS profileImage, pm.role AS role FROM project_member pm JOIN users u ON pm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT id as memberId, project_id as projectId, user_id as userId, role as role FROM project_member WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
